label: Town of Wilmington
header:
# Town of Wilmington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Thomas Fitzgerald (Chair), John Lebron, Vince Rice, Tony Tribuno, and Charlie Foster (the directory's row for Foster is transposed)

Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): Thomas J. Fitzgerald was elected to the two-year seat (161 votes) and Tony Tribuno to the three-year seat (40 votes)
Town of Wilmington, Selectboard page (2026): Tom Fitzgerald (Chair), Vince Rice (Vice Chair), Tony Tribuno, Charlie Foster, and John Lebron
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): Robert M. Fisher was elected Town Moderator (202 votes)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Therese Lounsbury as Wilmington's Town Clerk
Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': Town Clerk Therese Lounsbury, three-year term expiring 2028; she attested the March 2026 certificate of votes

Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': Christine Richter appears under APPOINTED OFFICIALS as Finance Officer; no treasurer contest appears on the March 2026 ballot. The office is modeled as appointed (flagged on issue #163)
Town of Wilmington, Treasurer/Finance Office page: 'Finance Officer/Treasurer and Tax Collector: Christine Richter' -- she also serves as collector of taxes; no separate collector post is modeled
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Christine Richter as Wilmington's Town Treasurer
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect constables

Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): Gordon 'Joe' Boyd was elected First Constable (191 votes). He held the Second Constable office in 2025; the 2025 First Constable, Gary Wax, has departed
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect constables); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): for Second Constable the certificate records 'NONE REACHING 17 REQUIRED VOTES' among the write-ins, so the seat is unfilled and no holder is minted

Town of Wilmington, Pettee Memorial Library Trustees page: 'Library Trustees are elected one each year for five-year terms' -- Tom Young (Chair), Monique Johnson, Chrystal Holt, Marie Paige, and Mary Genella
Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): Mary Genella was elected Library Trustee for five years (195 votes)

Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': the pre-2026 roster lists Carolyn Palmer (expiring 2026, succeeded by Genella) and Louis Clark (to 2029) in the seat the live page gives to Tom Young; Clark's departure is unpublished and the live page governs -- flagged on issue #163

Town of Wilmington, Cemetery Commission page: '2026 Cemetery Commission Members (5 year terms)' -- Janet Boyd (2027), Richard Khachadoorian (2028), Walter White (2029), Ralph Staib (2031), and one seat vacant (2030)
Town of Wilmington, Certificate of Votes for March 3, 2026 (attested by Therese M. Lounsbury, Town Clerk): Ralph C. Staib was elected Cemetery Commissioner for five years (197 votes)
Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': the pre-2026 roster names Jennifer Goodell in the 2030 seat the live page shows vacant; Goodell has departed

sources.note: Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': the elected officials table carries the heading 'Trustee of C.C. Haynes Fund' with no holder named; the seat count is also unpublished, so the post is created with one seat and no membership, flagged on issue #163

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Wilmington Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists six Wilmington justices of the peace: Bonnie L. Lorimer, Margaret 'Meg' Streeter, Joanne Fowler, Andrew Kirkman, John Lebron, and Polly 'Nicki' Steel

Town of Wilmington, 2025 Town Report, '2025 Town Officers, Boards, and Commissions': the town's justice of the peace roster lists six names plus a 'Vacant' line (seven seats): the certified winner Joanne Fowler no longer appears, and Matthew Moore sits in her place; Moore is seated as an appointee to the vacancy (mechanism unpublished; flagged on issue #163)

jp_election.name: Town of Wilmington Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the November 5, 2024 election of six justices of the peace for Wilmington: Bonnie L. Lorimer, Margaret 'Meg' Streeter, Joanne Fowler, Andrew Kirkman, John Lebron, and Polly 'Nicki' Steel. Fowler is not carried as a winner: the town's 2025 Town Report roster shows Matthew Moore sitting in her place, so she is treated as a departed winner and excluded entirely (the contest's vote_for remains six); Moore sits as an appointee
